title: Impact of head-silencing on cosine similarity

cues.en: This will be an interesting set of videos.
cues.zh: 這會是一組有趣的影片。

cues.en: We're going to manipulate attention heads similar to the previous couple of videos, but now, instead
cues.zh: 我們會像前幾支影片一樣操作注意力頭，但現在，

cues.en: of just measuring the impact on the final output of the model, we are going to measure the impact on
cues.zh: 不只衡量對模型最終輸出的影響，而是衡量對

cues.en: the cosine similarity of embeddings vectors in the hidden states or the outputs of the transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 隱藏狀態，也就是 Transformer 區塊輸出中，嵌入向量餘弦相似度的影響。

cues.en: That's an interesting way to assess whether the vector adjustments calculated by the attention heads
cues.zh: 這是有趣的評估方式，看看注意力頭計算出的向量調整，

cues.en: are impacting the way that the token representations are related to each other.
cues.zh: 是否影響 token 表徵彼此的關係。

cues.en: So the purpose of this video is for me to show you some code to set up and run a basic analysis, and
cues.zh: 所以，這支影片的目的，是展示程式碼，設定、執行基本分析，

cues.en: then in the next video, you will expand on this concept in several ways.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，再讓你從幾個方向延伸這個概念。

cues.en: I will work with GPT two medium in this demo.
cues.zh: 這個示範使用 GPT2 medium。

cues.en: Here is what the hook function looks like.
cues.zh: 這裡是 hook 函數的樣子。

cues.en: Basically the same as what you've seen before.
cues.zh: 基本上，與之前看過的相同。

cues.en: I'm hooking into the input layer of C proj, picking out one head and setting it to zero.
cues.zh: 掛接 c_proj 的輸入層，挑一個頭，設成零。

cues.en: Now in this video, I'm zeroing out all of the tokens in this head, and then in the next video you
cues.zh: 這支影片，將該頭的全部 token 歸零；下一支影片，

cues.en: are going to isolate just one specific head based on a particular meaning of one token in the text.
cues.zh: 則會根據文字中某個 token 的特定意義，獨立選出一個特定頭。

cues.en: And what is that text that we will use here?
cues.zh: 這裡要用什麼文字？

cues.en: It's this peanut butter and pineapple taste great on pizza.
cues.zh: 就是：花生醬與鳳梨放在披薩上很好吃。

cues.zh: 如果你是義大利人，或喜愛義大利的人，我保證，這只是開玩笑。

cues.en: I'm just being silly.
cues.zh: 我只是鬧著玩。

cues.en: I'm not being serious at all, just trying to have some fun here.
cues.zh: 完全不是認真的，只是想找點樂子。

cues.en: And if you are not Italian, then this sentence is absolutely true and I stand by it.
cues.zh: 如果你不是義大利人，那這個句子絕對是真的，我堅持這個說法。

cues.en: And you should definitely try peanut butter and pineapple on your next pizza.
cues.zh: 下次吃披薩，一定要試試花生醬與鳳梨。

cues.en: Anyway, so the idea here is that we will calculate cosine similarity across all the pairs of tokens
cues.zh: 總之，概念是，先把某一層的一個頭歸零，

cues.en: after zeroing out one of the heads in a layer.
cues.zh: 再計算所有 token 配對的餘弦相似度。

cues.en: And why do we do that?
cues.zh: 為什麼這樣做？

cues.en: Remember that the primary goal of the attention subblock is to integrate contextual information across the different tokens in a text.
cues.zh: 記得，注意力子區塊的主要目標，是整合文字中不同 token 的上下文資訊。

cues.en: And so if that is the case, then silencing the attention heads should have some impact on the cosine
cues.zh: 如果如此，讓注意力頭靜音，應該會影響不同 token

cues.en: similarity between the representations of the different tokens.
cues.zh: 表徵之間的餘弦相似度。

cues.en: So to measure that I'm going to run through a for loop that looks like this.
cues.zh: 為了衡量，會執行這樣的 for 迴圈。

cues.en: So here's a for loop over all of the layers.
cues.zh: 這裡遍歷所有層。

cues.en: Here I'm grabbing all of the data from one layer into a matrix that is tokens by embeddings.
cues.zh: 從某一層取得全部資料，放進 token 乘上嵌入的矩陣。

cues.en: And I'm skipping the first token here in the sequence for reasons, you know.
cues.zh: 這裡跳過序列第一個 token，原因你知道。

cues.en: And here I'm also adding plus one to the layer index.
cues.zh: 這裡也對層索引加一。

cues.en: I would like you to think about why I'm doing that.
cues.zh: 請思考一下，為何這樣做。

cues.en: This is something that's come up several times in the course, but always good to have a reminder anyway.
cues.zh: 這在課程中出現過幾次，但再提醒總是好的。

cues.en: Of course I will discuss the answer to why we want this plus one when I switch to code, but something for you to think about before I get there.
cues.zh: 切換到程式碼時，當然會討論為何需要加一，但在那之前，先留給你思考。

cues.en: Anyway, I hope the rest of this code looks familiar to you from earlier in the course.
cues.zh: 總之，希望其餘程式碼，對你來說都與課程前面一樣熟悉。

cues.en: So here in this line I normalize all of the embeddings vectors by their norm.
cues.zh: 這一行，用各個嵌入向量本身的範數，將它們正規化。

cues.en: And then I multiply that matrix by its transpose which gives me a matrix of cosine similarities.
cues.zh: 再讓這個矩陣乘上自身轉置，得到餘弦相似度矩陣。

cues.en: And then here I'm just grabbing the and storing all of the unique elements above the diagonal.
cues.zh: 接著，只取得、儲存對角線上方所有不重複元素。

cues.en: Now if this code looks a little confusing at first, then don't worry, I will go through it again in the code demo to make sure you understand what's going on with all this indexing business.
cues.zh: 如果一開始覺得這段程式碼有點困惑，不用擔心，示範中會再逐步說明，確保你理解這些索引操作。

cues.en: Now this variable keys is tokens by tokens up here.
cues.zh: 上面這個變數 keys，是 token 乘上 token。

cues.en: I create a variable called unique count, which I define as n by one times n by two divided by two.
cues.zh: 我建立 unique count 變數，定義為 n 減一，乘上 n 減二，再除以二。

cues.en: What does this formula mean and what does it correspond to?
cues.zh: 這個公式是什麼意思，對應什麼？

cues.en: Again, I will discuss the answer to that question when I switch to code, but I want to give you an opportunity to think about it first.
cues.zh: 同樣，切換到程式碼時會討論答案，但我想先給你機會思考。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Once I get all of the cosine similarities across all of the token pairs for each layer, I will then repeat this code, but silencing one head from each layer.
cues.zh: 取得每一層所有 token 配對的餘弦相似度後，會重複這段程式碼，但每層都讓一個頭靜音。

cues.en: I'm not going to loop through all of the attention heads.
cues.zh: 不會遍歷所有注意力頭。

cues.en: That's something you will do in the code challenge in the next video.
cues.zh: 那是下一支影片程式挑戰要做的。

cues.en: So here I just fixed the head to silence at one.
cues.zh: 這裡把要靜音的頭固定為一。

cues.en: So index one.
cues.zh: 也就是索引 1。

cues.en: And here you see those results.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到結果。

cues.en: So let me first direct your attention to this plot.
cues.zh: 先請注意這張圖。

cues.en: On the left we have the transformer block on the x axis, cosine similarity strength on the y axis.
cues.zh: 左邊，x 軸是 Transformer 區塊，y 軸是餘弦相似度強度。

cues.en: And each little square here corresponds to the cosine similarity between one of the token pairs.
cues.zh: 每個小方塊，對應某一對 token 的餘弦相似度。

cues.en: So this is in the clean model.
cues.zh: 這是在乾淨模型中。

cues.en: So there's no manipulations in here.
cues.zh: 沒有操作。

cues.en: There's no zeroing out.
cues.zh: 沒有歸零。

cues.en: We haven't done anything to the model at this plot over here.
cues.zh: 這張圖的模型，還沒有做任何改變。

cues.en: So it's pretty neat to see that the cosine similarities generally decrease as we get deeper into the model.
cues.zh: 很有趣的是，餘弦相似度通常隨著深入模型而下降。

cues.en: And then they suddenly start to increase, going up to a ceiling of one as we work our way towards the end of the model.
cues.zh: 接著突然開始增加，越接近模型末端，就越接近上限一。

cues.en: So it looks like the model is kind of decoupling these representations of different tokens as it's trying
cues.zh: 所以，模型似乎在載入上下文、理解例如花生醬、鳳梨和披薩

cues.en: to load context and figure out what is the relationship between, for example, peanut butter and pineapple and pizza.
cues.zh: 之間的關係時，將不同 token 的表徵解耦。

cues.en: And then towards the end of the model, it starts to converge onto a prediction.
cues.zh: 接著，接近模型末端時，開始收斂到一個預測。

cues.en: So those embeddings vectors also start to converge.
cues.zh: 因此，這些嵌入向量也開始收斂。

cues.en: Anyway, this middle panel shows the same analysis, but with silencing one of the attention heads.
cues.zh: 中間面板，是相同分析，但讓其中一個注意力頭靜音。

cues.en: Now at first pass visual inspection, it doesn't really seem like there are huge differences between these two panels.
cues.zh: 初步視覺檢查，兩張圖似乎沒有巨大差異。

cues.en: That's to be expected.
cues.zh: 這是預期之中。

cues.en: Zeroing out one attention head is not a gigantic manipulation.
cues.zh: 將一個注意力頭歸零，不是巨大的操作。

cues.en: And here in the third plot, you can see the differences between the clean and the silenced models for cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 第三張圖，可以看到乾淨與靜音模型之間，餘弦相似度的差異。

cues.en: I've ordered the subtraction here such that positive values in this difference score mean stronger cosine
cues.zh: 減法的順序設定為：差值分數為正，表示靜音後餘弦

cues.en: similarity after silencing and negative values mean weaker cosine similarity after silencing one of the attention heads.
cues.zh: 相似度更強；負值則表示，讓一個頭靜音後，餘弦相似度更弱。

cues.en: I also ran a t test across these differences for all of the token pairs against zero.
cues.zh: 我也對全部 token 配對的差值，相對於零做 t 檢定。

cues.en: That's the horizontal line here where the T test was non-significant.
cues.zh: 這是這裡的水平線，t 檢定不顯著的地方，

cues.en: There are red x's and where it was significant.
cues.zh: 用紅色叉號；顯著的地方，

cues.en: You see these triangle markers.
cues.zh: 則看到三角形標記。

cues.en: So the effect size is in general quite small around an order of magnitude smaller than the overall magnitude of the cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 效果量一般相當小，大約比餘弦相似度的整體量值小一個數量級。

cues.en: In other words, the impact of ablating one head is generally quite small, but in many cases it is consistent across the different token pairs.
cues.zh: 換句話說，消融一個頭的影響通常很小，但很多情況下，在不同 token 配對之間一致。

cues.en: Interestingly, it also seems like the direction of the effect changes over the different layers.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，效果方向似乎也會隨不同層改變。

cues.en: So sometimes silencing the head promotes coupling of the embeddings vectors, and for other layers it promotes decoupling.
cues.zh: 有時，讓頭靜音會促進嵌入向量耦合，有些層則促進解耦。

cues.en: So in this figure here, I silenced one head in each layer and then measured cosine similarity of the transformer outputs in that same letter.
cues.zh: 這張圖，每層讓一個頭靜音，再測量相同層 Transformer 輸出的餘弦相似度。

cues.en: The next analysis I did was only to silence exactly one head only in layer three, but then measure
cues.zh: 下一個分析，只在第三號層讓一個頭靜音，但測量

cues.en: And a lot of these layers are not statistically significantly different from zero in terms of their change from silence versus clean.

cues.en: But actually towards the end you do see some consistent impact of silencing that one head all the way
